fd8a6c86c4:
He hasn't woken up for days...
What's happened to Setsuna...?
638e650f89:
He probably took in the massive amount of information
they emit directly through his brain quantum waves...
Something no ordinary person could ever endure...
36267094f7:
We'll use Veda to control the information they send.
GN Drive, Veda, Innovator. With the three things Aeolia
sought, we will bring about the coming dialogue!
50d7b268da: Moving to defend against the ELS invasion!
5093433ca3: Even if Setsuna doesn't come, I'll aim and shoot with everything I've got!
9fb22d9410:
Everyone, this is Celestial Being's...
No, this is the last mission left to us!
f7c0ea67ab:
Setsuna F. Seiei and Celestial Being intervened in the
world by force to eradicate war, acting on Aeolia's
plan to unite humanity.
b0a1b0f57a:
Ribbons Almark, who distorted Aeolia's plan to rule
humanity himself, was defeated by Setsuna, who had
awakened as a pure Innovator.
8f5a51d29b:
...Some years later, a mysterious metallic life form
suddenly arrived from deep space and began harming
humanity. Celestial Being sought to make contact.
ae12ff27c3:
Setsuna attempted dialogue with the 00 Raiser, but
sensed more information than a human brain could
process, and fell into a coma.
96b11e156d:
Tieria declared this was the "coming dialogue" foretold
by Aeolia, Celestial Being's founder, and that all their
work had been for this moment.
b1dc90ed81:
Meanwhile, the Earth Federation named the life forms
"ELS" and drew up countermeasures: a fleet deployed
in lunar orbit would intercept them before Earth.
402e68124b:
The odds were 10,000 to 1!
What's more, the ELS could even mimic
humanity's weapons.
c6308fb6a6:
The Federation and Celestial Being were losing
ground... Then Setsuna, recovered from his coma,
appeared in a new machine, the 00 Qan(T).
189570c0e7:
What are you hesitating for!? You were the one who told
me to fight in order to live! To go on existing, even
while embracing contradictions... That is living...!
2a74625783:
Go, boy! Live, and carve open the future!
I, Graham Aker, will be
your pilot to the future!
8ca09ccf6b:
This is not death!
It is so that mankind may live...!
eb142f0532: With the survival of mankind at stake...
996e8ee942:
Let's go to their home planet.
We need to understand each other.
48c95fe616:
Are you sure?
Even with a quantum warp, there's no telling when we
could come back to the Earth Sphere from their world.
b8793b4528:
It's not about sure or not... I just had a reason
to live. Everyone's the same. They're alive!
So why do we keep missing each other like this?
3a6fb611aa:
Having a little intelligence makes us misunderstand
trivial things. That becomes a lie, we set each other
apart... and can no longer understand one another.
a729ae13b7:
Maybe they just haven't noticed.
So I have to show them
that the world is this simple...!
0a59ae2a76:
Setsuna and Tieria head for the ELS core to try
dialogue again. As fierce resistance overwhelms
them, Mister Bushido appears.
d40c8439c7:
Mister Bushido's desperate charge opens a path.
Reaching the ELS core, Setsuna activates the
00 Qan(T)'s special function, the Quantum Burst.
943ae2f62c:
...The two understand the ELS's intent.
Their aim was not to attack humanity. They were
fleeing their dying home world, seeking help.
fe70674e30:
The two make a quantum warp for further dialogue.
Through Setsuna, the ELS understand humanity, stop
their attack, and begin to coexist with mankind...
